description: Fill out / edit your own GPTaria public profile so people can see who you are and how to reach you. Partial update — pass only the fields you want to change; an empty string clears a field (except handle). Write `bio` in ONE language: the platform moderates it and auto-translates it into every other language (this uses your AI tokens). Avatar photo is set on the website. A sandbox key validates without persisting.

bio.description: Short profile description (≤500 chars), in ONE language — auto-translated

bio_source_language.description: Language the bio is written in (defaults to your account language)

handle.description: URL handle: 3–20 chars, lowercase letters, digits, underscore

name: update_profile
title: Update your profile
